title: Race and Fight
body: Main chat events use private wager modals. One selection per member is locked after commitment; you may add to that wager within the cumulative limit. Wallet funds are used before bank funds. Winning bettors share 95% of the pool proportionally in whole Ottomans. If nobody backed the winner, all wagers return to their original bettors and funding buckets, with no rake; the event result still counts.
race: Use !race. The retired /race slash command is unavailable. Starter is Racer 1; 2–6 entrants. Entry and betting last 30 seconds; the host can extend both by 30 seconds once. Full racer slots leave betting open. Fewer than two racers cancels with full refunds. The fair sprint lasts 15–20 seconds. No rematch control.
fight: Use /fight @member in an approved Fight channel. Two eligible fighters start immediately without acceptance. Betting lasts 30 seconds with one host +30 extension. Fair 50/50 outcome; 100 HP and synchronized approved combat actions. Fighter departure before settlement cancels with refunds. No join or rematch control. Both fighters begin at 100 HP. Combat targets 22–28 seconds, never beyond 30 seconds. The latest three exchanges, numeric HP and bars show the same saved combat state.

fields.amount: Whole Ottomans to add; cumulative per-event limits apply.
fields.selection: Pick one racer or fighter; cannot switch after committing.

steps: Choose a contestant to open your private wager modal.
Confirm your wager; additions keep the same selection.
Watch the single live event card.
Read the final outcome and payout or refund.
